# Chikem Mod v1.4.1

Adds Special Chickems, difficulty-based breeding chances, and treasure loot for GolChick Food + Goldie Egg.

## Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader: 0.18.1+
- Fabric API: 0.141.3+1.21.11
- Java: 21+

## Download
- `chikem-mod-1.4.1.jar`

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader.
2. Install Fabric API.
3. Put the downloaded JAR into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

## Links
- Source: https://github.com/Prarambha369/chikemMod
- Issues: https://github.com/Prarambha369/chikemMod/issues

## Chikem Mod v1.4.0

A major gameplay polish update focused on spawn balancing, loot integration, breeding behavior, and project cleanup.

### Added
- Difficulty-based chickem probability tuning (Peaceful / Easy / Normal / Hard / Hardcore)
- Natural structure/chest treasure integration for GolChick Food and Goldie Egg

### Changed
- Improved in-game visual descriptions and presentation text for better mod UX
- Updated balancing around special breeding/feed behavior

### Fixed
- Breeding heart particles appearing inconsistently
- Breeding timing behavior to follow intended cooldown/feed rules
- Cleanup of duplicate/unnecessary files and warning reduction work

### Compatibility
- Minecraft Java: `1.21` to `1.21.5`
- Loader: `Fabric`
- Environment: Singleplayer (and server support if applicable in your current build)

### Notes
If you find bugs, please report them in GitHub Issues.
